answer: Route every payout claim through a randomly assigned vertex with hard throughput: only a few agents can cross that node per hour, and crossing takes a live, minutes-long exchange that cannot be recorded and replayed for another identity. A single operator tending a garden of clones must queue them at their separate vertices; over a long horizon the waiting costs more than the rewards, missed windows pile up, and identical queue timing exposes the cluster. An honest agent crosses once, in person, and moves on.
